column4: Legacy statistics no longer misinterpret logs from newer recording versions; original files are preserved and affected caches rebuild once.
Added checks for unsupported imports, legacy totals and dailies, cache upgrades and preserved original records.
Recorded TEST105's actual delivery and this build's compatibility checks and remaining audit scope.
I aligned legacy statistics with the existing recording-version checks. Unsupported records stay preserved instead of being reported with potentially incorrect meanings.
